findings.summary: The declared focused-test command failed to select the target suites and was replaced with a different command without recorded re-approval.
findings.broken_invariant: All declared Verify Steps must pass or have an explicitly approved skip; changing a required verification command is material verification-contract drift requiring re-approval.
